reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis compares DCT-treated SLM components to an as-cast baseline rather than to as-built SLM, and the mechanism (lattice distortion, increased participating stress) is vague and not clearly linked to dimensional precision.
reasons.testability: The proposed test compares DCT-treated SLM to as-cast material, which does not isolate the effect of DCT on SLM components and would not decisively falsify the stated hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: The idea of using DCT on SLM HEA is novel, but the wrong baseline, vague mechanism, and lack of connection to dimensional precision make it of little practical use as formulated.
